_meta.purpose: Story case: token signing algorithm was upgraded (v1 → v2, HS256 → ES256 style) in an auth deploy that lacked backward compatibility. Existing cached tokens (in Redis) that were signed with v1 fail verification against v2 verifier, causing user login-related 5xx. Reproduces author's own production experience. Pattern is CHANGE (deploy caused) with a strong secondary tag of DATA (existing data in cache incompatible with new code).

title: [Triggered] auth 5xx rate above 5%
message: 5xx rate for auth has been > 5% for 1 minute.
text: auth service /verify is failing at high rate; users see logout / re-login required.
